body.x: The world’s most talented speakers just got even more talented with the addition of three new BRAVEN Bluetooth speaker models the 850, BRV-1, and 570.

Joining the BRAVEN family, the 850 is similar to the brand’s wildly popular Six Series, but is four times larger and delivers massive, industry-leading sound. The BRV-1 is uniquely suited for outdoor adventures with its compact, waterproof, ultra-shock-resistant design weighing in at less than 400 grams. The BRAVEN 570 delivers the same awesome industry-leading audio as its predecessors with a stylish, impact resistant exterior and a lower price point.

“Last year, BRAVEN thundered into the market with impossibly huge sound from speakers small enough to carry in your pocket”, says CEO Warren Osborn. “Once again BRAVEN is changing the game, pushing the Bluetooth speaker to new levels with products that play to the outdoor and sports enthusiast and bring in new fans."
All of BRAVEN’s products can be seen and heard at booth # 3818 at the 2013 International CES January 8-11, 2013 in Las Vegas, Nevada.
